findings.current_path_basis: No external ELF imports QUIC constructors or peer-address APIs. curl reports no HTTP3; ssl_client/libapk select ordinary TLS methods. Fourteen Go binaries use Go TLS, not OpenSSL.
Same exact QUIC constructor exclusion, not a generic TLS-client exemption.

findings.trigger_summary: AES-GCM-SIV repeated or empty incremental AAD and context reuse.
findings.current_path_basis: No external ELF carries GCM-SIV algorithm strings or selects that algorithm. Ordinary TLS ciphers do not select GCM-SIV. Main and plugins use Go crypto; no current entrypoint invokes OpenSSL encryption tools.

findings.trigger_summary: AES-GCM-SIV initialization with a non-12-byte IV.
findings.current_path_basis: Same exact GCM-SIV selection exclusion; no current application nonce is passed to this OpenSSL provider path.

findings.trigger_summary: CMS encryption to specially crafted EC recipients can loop in key generation.
findings.current_path_basis: No external ELF imports CMS_encrypt or CMS_encrypt_ex; no openssl CLI exists. Main smallstep/pkcs7 is pure Go. Current entrypoint does not execute a CMS tool.

native_consumers.certificate_hash_utility: usr/bin/c_rehash imports certificate/CRL parsing and digest/hash functions, not CMS encryption or cipher init.
native_consumers.library_implementation: libssl itself exports QUIC and libcrypto contains CMS/GCM-SIV. These implementations are present and not claimed fixed.
native_consumers.generic_crypto_consumers: afalg/padlock/loader_attic engines and legacy provider are inventoried; generic EVP APIs in a module do not prove GCM-SIV selected. The current OpenSSL configuration only names the default provider; no active engine or extra provider module is configured.
native_consumers.dynamic_lookup: Only bash and libcrypto import dlopen/dlsym in all97ELFs. bash supports loadable builtins, but /run.sh contains no enable -f or source/import hook; actual current daily config has no BASH_ENV/LD/OPENSSL overrides. libcrypto retains provider/engine loading capabilities; config has no active external engine/provider path.
